pk.context: 150 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Exposure rises 2.5- to 4-fold when taken with fat-containing food. About 99% is bound to plasma proteins, and it is mainly metabolized by CYP3A, with 87.8% of the dose eliminated in feces.
clues.substance: Molecular weight 392.5. A white to off-white powder that is practically insoluble in water.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA as 150 mg tablets and as unit-dose granule packets of 5.8 to 75 mg. Dosed every 12 hours.
clues.safety: No boxed warning and no contraindications. Headache and upper respiratory tract infection are the most common adverse reactions.
clues.indication: Cystic fibrosis in patients aged 1 month and older who have at least one mutation in the disease gene that responds to it.
clues.mechanism: Raises the open probability (gating) of the CFTR chloride channel at the cell surface, increasing chloride transport.

tell: Light blue oblong tablets and a 2.5- to 4-fold food-driven exposure boost set this CFTR potentiator apart.
